	local fov = Aimbot.Config.FOV

	local best, bestScore = nil, math.huge
	local targets = collectTargets()

	for _, entry in ipairs(targets) do
		local skip = false
		if not entry.Alive then skip = true end
		if Aimbot.Config.TeamCheck and entry.IsTeammate then skip = true end
		if Aimbot.Config.IgnoreDisguised and entry.Disguised then skip = true end
		if Aimbot.Config.IgnoreUnconscious and entry.Unconscious then skip = true end
		if entry.Distance > 3000 then skip = true end

		if not skip then
			local part = getAimPart(entry, Aimbot.Config.Part)
			local ok, screen, onScreen = pcall(function()
				return cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
			end)
			if ok and onScreen then
				local screenPos = Vector2.new(screen.X, screen.Y)
				local distFromCenter = (screenPos - center).Magnitude
				if distFromCenter <= fov then
					-- Pontuação: ângulo pesa mais que distância
					local score = distFromCenter * 0.7 + entry.Distance * 0.3
					if score < bestScore then
						if hasLineOfSight(cam, part) then
							best, bestScore = entry, score
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return best
end

function Aimbot:Apply()
	if not Aimbot.Enabled then return end
	local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not cam then return end

	-- Modo Native: usa o `assist` do próprio jogo
	if Aimbot.Config.Mode == "Native" and nativeAssist then
		local proxy = setmetatable({}, {
			__index = function(_, k)
				if k == "Position" then return cam.CFrame.Position end
				if k == "LookVector" then return cam.CFrame.LookVector end
				if k == "CFrame" then return cam.CFrame end
				return nil
			end,
		})
		local ok, friction, turnX, turnY = pcall(nativeAssist, proxy, 1 / 60, 1, 60)
		if ok and turnX and turnY and (math.abs(turnX) > 1e-6 or math.abs(turnY) > 1e-6) then
			local smooth = Aimbot.Config.Smoothness
			cam.CFrame = cam.CFrame * CFrame.fromEulerAnglesYXZ(turnY * smooth, turnX * smooth, 0)
		end
		return
	end

	local target = Aimbot:FindTarget()
	if not target then return end

	local part = getAimPart(target, Aimbot.Config.Part)
	local targetPos = part.Position

	if Aimbot.Config.Mode == "Camera" then
		local currentCF = cam.CFrame
		local goalCF = CFrame.lookAt(currentCF.Position, targetPos)
		local alpha = math.clamp(1 / math.max(Aimbot.Config.Smoothness, 1), 0.02, 1)
		cam.CFrame = currentCF:Lerp(goalCF, alpha)
	end
	-- "Silent": aplicado no hook de shoot (fora do escopo desta versão)
end

-- ═══════════════════════ AIM ASSIST NATIVO (aba separada) ═══════════════════════
local NativeAA = {
	Enabled = false,
	Config = {
		Strength = 1,
		Smoothness = 1,
	},
	LastTurn = Vector2.new(0, 0),
}

local function runNativeAssist(dt)
	if not nativeAssist then return end
	local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not cam then return end

	local proxy = setmetatable({}, {
		__index = function(_, k)
			if k == "Position" then return cam.CFrame.Position end
			if k == "LookVector" then return cam.CFrame.LookVector end
			if k == "CFrame" then return cam.CFrame end
			return nil
		end,
	})

	local strength = math.clamp(NativeAA.Config.Strength, 0, 1)
	local ok, friction, turnX, turnY = pcall(nativeAssist, proxy, dt, strength, 300)
	if not ok or not turnX or not turnY then
		NativeAA.LastTurn = Vector2.new(0, 0)
		return
	end
	NativeAA.LastTurn = Vector2.new(turnX or 0, turnY or 0)

	if math.abs(turnX) < 1e-6 and math.abs(turnY) < 1e-6 then return end

	local smooth = math.clamp(NativeAA.Config.Smoothness, 0.1, 10)
	cam.CFrame = cam.CFrame * CFrame.fromEulerAnglesYXZ(
		(turnY or 0) / smooth,
		(turnX or 0) / smooth,
		0
	)
end

-- ═══════════════════════ LOOP PRINCIPAL ═══════════════════════
local accumulator = 0
local espInterval = 1 / 120  -- ESP a 120Hz máximo (economiza PhysicsFps)

local function onRender(dt)
	if not State.Enabled then return end
	accumulator = accumulator + dt

	-- AIMBOT roda todo frame (precisa de precisão)
	if Aimbot.Enabled then
		pcall(Aimbot.Apply, Aimbot)
	end
	if NativeAA.Enabled then
		pcall(runNativeAssist, dt)
	end

	-- ESP roda com throttle: 1/120s ou quando acumular
	if accumulator >= espInterval then
		accumulator = 0
		clearFrame()
		if ESP.Enabled then
			pcall(ESP.Render, ESP)
		end
	end
end

-- ═══════════════════════ API PÚBLICA ═══════════════════════
function Core:Start()
	if State.Enabled then return end
	State.Enabled = true
	addConn(RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(onRender))
end

function Core:Stop()
	State.Enabled = false
	clearFrame()
end

function Core:IsRunning()
	return State.Enabled
end

function Core:SetESP(enabled)
	ESP.Enabled = enabled
	if not enabled then
		clearFrame()
	end
end

function Core:SetESPConfig(key, value)
	if ESP.Config[key] ~= nil then
		ESP.Config[key] = value
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function Core:SetAimbot(enabled)
	Aimbot.Enabled = enabled
end

function Core:SetAimbotConfig(key, value)
	if Aimbot.Config[key] ~= nil then
		Aimbot.Config[key] = value
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function Core:Aimbot()
	return Aimbot
end

function Core:ESP()
	return ESP
end

function Core:NativeAA()
	return NativeAA
end

function Core:SetNativeAA(enabled)
	NativeAA.Enabled = enabled
end

function Core:SetNativeAAConfig(key, value)
	if NativeAA.Config[key] ~= nil then
		NativeAA.Config[key] = value
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function Core:GetTargets()
	return collectTargets()
end

function Core:GetSectorBoard()
	return SectorBoard
end

function Core:ApplyBypass()
	return Bypass:Enable()
end

function Core:RemoveBypass()
	return Bypass:Disable()
end

function Core:BypassEnabled()
	return Bypass:IsEnabled()
end

function Core:HasNativeAssist()
	return nativeAssist ~= nil
end

-- ═══════════════════════ UNLOAD ═══════════════════════
function Core:Destroy()
	State.Enabled = false
	ESP.Enabled = false
	Aimbot.Enabled = false
	NativeAA.Enabled = false

	clearFrame()

	for _, fn in ipairs(State.Cleanups) do
		pcall(fn)
	end
	table.clear(State.Cleanups)

	for _, conn in ipairs(State.Connections) do
		pcall(function() conn:Disconnect() end)
	end
	table.clear(State.Connections)
end

-- ═══════════════════════ DIAGNÓSTICO ═══════════════════════
function Core:Diagnostics()
	local diag = {}
	table.insert(diag, "Drawing: " .. (Drawing and "OK" or "AUSENTE"))
	table.insert(diag, "LimbHealth: " .. (LimbHealth and "OK" or "AUSENTE"))
	table.insert(diag, "SectorBoard: " .. (SectorBoard and "OK" or "AUSENTE"))
	table.insert(diag, "assist nativo: " .. (nativeAssist and "OK" or "AUSENTE"))
	table.insert(diag, "bypass: " .. (Bypass:IsEnabled() and "ATIVO" or "inativo"))
	table.insert(diag, "alvos vivos: " .. tostring(#collectTargets()))
	return table.concat(diag, "\n")
end

-- DEBUG removido

return Core

end
local Core = __load_Core()

-- ===================================================================
-- OVERRIDER (reescrita por frame)
-- ===================================================================
local function __load_Overrider()
--[[
	═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
	OVERRIDER — reescreve propriedades que o jogo reseta a cada frame

	Descoberta crítica: WalkSpeed, FOV, SpeedMultiplier e FieldOfView
	são reescritos pelo jogo todo frame. Escrever uma vez não persiste,
	mas escrever em RenderStepped com alta prioridade SIM.

	Custo: um único loop, ~0.01ms por propriedade reivindicada.
	═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
]]

local Overrider = {}

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

Overrider._claims = {}      -- [key] = { get = fn, set = fn, value = any, name = str }
Overrider._conn = nil
Overrider._stats = { frames = 0, writes = 0 }

local RENDER_PRIORITY = Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 10

-- ═══════════════════════ API ═══════════════════════

-- Registra uma propriedade para ser reivindicada por frame.
-- key: identificador único · setter: function(value) · value: valor desejado
function Overrider.Claim(key, name, setter, value)
	Overrider._claims[key] = {
		name = name,
		set = setter,
		value = value,
	}
	return true
end

function Overrider.Release(key)
	Overrider._claims[key] = nil
	return true
end

function Overrider.Set(key, value)
	local claim = Overrider._claims[key]
	if not claim then return false end
	claim.value = value
	pcall(claim.set, value)
	return true
end

function Overrider.Get(key)
	local claim = Overrider._claims[key]
	return claim and claim.value
end

function Overrider.IsClaimed(key)
	return Overrider._claims[key] ~= nil
end

function Overrider.Count()
	local n = 0
	for _ in pairs(Overrider._claims) do n = n + 1 end
	return n
end

function Overrider.Stats()
	return Overrider._stats.frames, Overrider._stats.writes
end

-- ═══════════════════════ LOOP ═══════════════════════

local function tick()
	local claims = Overrider._claims
	local writes = 0
	for key, claim in pairs(claims) do
		local ok = pcall(claim.set, claim.value)
		if ok then writes = writes + 1 end
	end
	Overrider._stats.frames = Overrider._stats.frames + 1
	Overrider._stats.writes = Overrider._stats.writes + writes
end

function Overrider.Start()
	if Overrider._conn then return end
	local ok = pcall(function()
		RunService:BindToRenderStep("CORE_OVERRIDER", RENDER_PRIORITY, tick)
	end)
	if not ok then
		Overrider._conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(tick)
	end
	Overrider._active = true
end

function Overrider.Stop()
	if not Overrider._active then return end
	pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("CORE_OVERRIDER") end)
	if Overrider._conn then
		pcall(function() Overrider._conn:Disconnect() end)
		Overrider._conn = nil
	end
	Overrider._active = false
end

function Overrider.IsActive()
	return Overrider._active == true
end

function Overrider.Clear()
	table.clear(Overrider._claims)
end

-- ═══════════════════════ HELPERS DE CAMPOS ═══════════════════════
-- Atalhos para os campos que o Cold War faz reset.

local function getLocalCharacter()
	return LocalPlayer.Character
end

local function getHumanoid()
	local ch = getLocalCharacter()
	return ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
end

local function getCharValues()
	local ch = getLocalCharacter()
	return ch and ch:FindFirstChild("CharacterValues")
end

-- WalkSpeed — recalculado por MovementTuning a cada frame
function Overrider.ClaimWalkSpeed(speed)
	return Overrider.Claim("walkspeed", "WalkSpeed", function(v)
		local hum = getHumanoid()
		if hum then hum.WalkSpeed = v end
	end, speed)
end

-- JumpPower — persiste sozinho, mas reivindicar não custa nada
function Overrider.ClaimJumpPower(power)
	return Overrider.Claim("jumppower", "JumpPower", function(v)
		local hum = getHumanoid()
		if hum then
			hum.UseJumpPower = true
			hum.JumpPower = v
		end
	end, power)
end

-- FieldOfView — recalculado pelo CameraModule
function Overrider.ClaimFOV(fov)
	return Overrider.Claim("fov", "FieldOfView", function(v)
		local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
		if cam then cam.FieldOfView = v end
	end, fov)
end

-- SpeedMultiplier do CharacterValues — replicado do servidor
function Overrider.ClaimSpeedMultiplier(mult)
	return Overrider.Claim("speedmult", "SpeedMultiplier", function(v)
		local cv = getCharValues()
		local sm = cv and cv:FindFirstChild("SpeedMultiplier")
		if sm then sm.Value = v end
	end, mult)
end

-- HipHeight — altura do personagem
function Overrider.ClaimHipHeight(h)
	return Overrider.Claim("hipheight", "HipHeight", function(v)
		local hum = getHumanoid()
		if hum then hum.HipHeight = v end
	end, h)
end

return Overrider

end
local Overrider = __load_Overrider()

-- ===================================================================
-- MODULES (Player, Movimento, Gun, Info)
-- ===================================================================
local function __load_Modules()
--[[
	═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
	MÓDULOS ADICIONAIS — baseados em testes ao vivo
	Player · Movimento · Gun · Info

	Correções aplicadas (ver CORRECOES-CATALOGO.md):
	  · SpeedMultiplier é BLOCKED (server-authoritative)
	  · WalkSpeed funciona via Overrider
	  · JumpPower persiste sozinho
	  · Lighting persiste
	  · FOV precisa de Overrider
	═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
]]

local M = {}

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local function char() return LocalPlayer.Character end
local function hum() local c = char() return c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") end
local function hrp() local c = char() return c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") end
local function cvals() local c = char() return c and c:FindFirstChild("CharacterValues") end

-- ═══════════════════════ GUARDA DE ESTADO ═══════════════════════
-- O Cold War deixa o Character sem Humanoid quando o jogador morre.
-- Sem isso, dezenas de funções falham silenciosamente.
M._lastError = nil

function M.IsAlive()
	local h = hum()
	return h ~= nil and h.Health > 0
end

function M.RequireAlive()
	if M.IsAlive() then return true end
	M._lastError = "Você está morto ou respawnando"
	return false, M._lastError
end

function M.LastError()
	return M._lastError
end

function M.ClearError()
	M._lastError = nil
end

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- ESTADO / BACKUPS
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
M._conns = {}
M._backup = {}

local function track(conn)
	table.insert(M._conns, conn)
	return conn
end

local function backup(key, value)
	if M._backup[key] == nil then M._backup[key] = value end
	return M._backup[key]
end

local function restore(key, setter)
	local v = M._backup[key]
	if v ~= nil then
		pcall(setter, v)
		M._backup[key] = nil
	end
end

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- PLAYER / UTILIDADE
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local P = {}
M.Player = P

-- --- Debuffs: zerar ValueObjects do próprio personagem ---
-- Suppression/Shock/Deafening são locais; o servidor calcula, mas o
-- efeito visual/sonoro é aplicado cliente-side a partir do valor.
P._debuffConn = nil

function P.MuteDebuffs(enabled)
	if P._debuffConn then
		pcall(function() P._debuffConn:Disconnect() end)
		P._debuffConn = nil
	end
	if not enabled then return end
	P._debuffConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local cv = cvals()
		if not cv then return end
		local s = cv:FindFirstChild("Suppression")
		local sh = cv:FindFirstChild("Shock")
		local d = cv:FindFirstChild("Deafening")
		pcall(function()
			if s then s.Value = 0 end
			if sh then sh.Value = 0 end
			if d then d.Value = 0 end
		end)
	end)
end

-- --- Efeitos de supressão no Lighting ---
P._supConn = nil

function P.NoSuppressionEffects(enabled)
	if P._supConn then
		pcall(function() P._supConn:Disconnect() end)
		P._supConn = nil
	end
	local names = { "SuppressionDepthOfField", "SuppressionBlur", "SuppressionColor" }
	local function apply()
		for _, n in ipairs(names) do
			local eff = Lighting:FindFirstChild(n)
			if eff then pcall(function() eff.Enabled = false end) end
		end
	end
	apply()
	if enabled then
		P._supConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
			apply()
		end)
	end
end

-- --- Full bright (persiste naturalmente) ---
function P.FullBright(enabled)
	if enabled then
		backup("Ambient", Lighting.Ambient)
		backup("OutdoorAmbient", Lighting.OutdoorAmbient)
		backup("Brightness", Lighting.Brightness)
		backup("GlobalShadows", Lighting.GlobalShadows)
		backup("EnvironmentDiffuseScale", Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale)
		backup("EnvironmentSpecularScale", Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale)
		pcall(function()
			Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(178, 178, 178)
			Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(178, 178, 178)
			Lighting.Brightness = 3
			Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
			Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = 0
			Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale = 0
		end)
	else
		restore("Ambient", function(v) Lighting.Ambient = v end)
		restore("OutdoorAmbient", function(v) Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = v end)
		restore("Brightness", function(v) Lighting.Brightness = v end)
		restore("GlobalShadows", function(v) Lighting.GlobalShadows = v end)
		restore("EnvironmentDiffuseScale", function(v) Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = v end)
		restore("EnvironmentSpecularScale", function(v) Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale = v end)
	end
end

-- --- No fog ---
function P.NoFog(enabled)
	if enabled then
		backup("FogEnd", Lighting.FogEnd)
		backup("FogStart", Lighting.FogStart)
		pcall(function()
			Lighting.FogEnd = 1000000
			Lighting.FogStart = 1000000
		end)
	else
		restore("FogEnd", function(v) Lighting.FogEnd = v end)
		restore("FogStart", function(v) Lighting.FogStart = v end)
	end
end

-- --- Terceira pessoa estendida ---
function P.ExtendedThirdPerson(enabled)
	if enabled then
		backup("MaxZoom", LocalPlayer.CameraMaxZoomDistance)
		backup("MinZoom", LocalPlayer.CameraMinZoomDistance)
		pcall(function()
			LocalPlayer.CameraMaxZoomDistance = 80
			LocalPlayer.CameraMinZoomDistance = 0.5
		end)
	else
		restore("MaxZoom", function(v) LocalPlayer.CameraMaxZoomDistance = v end)
		restore("MinZoom", function(v) LocalPlayer.CameraMinZoomDistance = v end)
	end
end

-- --- Remover efeitos de pós-processamento ---
P._ppSkip = {}
function P.RemovePostFX(enabled)
	for _, child in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("BlurEffect") or child:IsA("DepthOfFieldEffect")
			or child:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect") or child:IsA("SunRaysEffect")
			or child:IsA("BloomEffect") then
			if enabled then
				if P._ppSkip[child] == nil then P._ppSkip[child] = child.Enabled end
				pcall(function() child.Enabled = false end)
			else
				local was = P._ppSkip[child]
				if was ~= nil then pcall(function() child.Enabled = was end) end
			end
		end
	end
	if not enabled then table.clear(P._ppSkip) end
end

-- --- Remover vegetação ---
P._vegBackup = {}
function P.NoVegetation(enabled)
	local folder = Workspace:FindFirstChild("TreeBrushFolder")
	if not folder then return false end
	if enabled then
		for _, obj in ipairs(folder:GetDescendants()) do
			if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
				if P._vegBackup[obj] == nil then
					P._vegBackup[obj] = obj.LocalTransparencyModifier
				end
				pcall(function() obj.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1 end)
			end
		end
	else
		for obj, v in pairs(P._vegBackup) do
			pcall(function()
				if obj and obj.Parent then obj.LocalTransparencyModifier = v end
			end)
		end
		table.clear(P._vegBackup)
	end
	return true
end

-- --- Xray de construções ---
P._xrayBackup = {}
function P.Xray(enabled)
	local folder = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Map") or Workspace:FindFirstChild("Buildings")
	if not folder then return false end
	if enabled then
		for _, obj in ipairs(folder:GetDescendants()) do
			if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
				if P._xrayBackup[obj] == nil then
					P._xrayBackup[obj] = obj.LocalTransparencyModifier
				end
				pcall(function() obj.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0.8 end)
			end
		end
	else
		for obj, v in pairs(P._xrayBackup) do
			pcall(function()
				if obj and obj.Parent then obj.LocalTransparencyModifier = v end
			end)
		end
		table.clear(P._xrayBackup)
	end
	return true
end

-- --- Stance instantâneo ---
function P.SetStance(stance)
	local cv = cvals()
	local s = cv and cv:FindFirstChild("Stance")
	local sl = cv and cv:FindFirstChild("StanceLocal")
	pcall(function()
		if s then s.Value = stance end
		if sl then sl.Value = stance end
	end)
	return true
end

-- --- Auto-revive à distância (usa ProximityPrompt legítimo) ---
function P.ReviveNearby(maxDist)
	local root = hrp()
	if not root then
		local _, err = M.RequireAlive()
		return 0, err
	end
	local origin = root.Position
	local n = 0
	for _, pl in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if pl ~= LocalPlayer then
			local otherChar = pl.Character
			local otherHrp = otherChar and otherChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if otherHrp and (otherHrp.Position - origin).Magnitude <= (maxDist or 12) then
				local prompt = otherHrp:FindFirstChild("RevivePrompt")
				if prompt and prompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
					pcall(fireproximityprompt, prompt)
					n = n + 1
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return n
end

-- --- Carregar colega à distância ---
function P.CarryNearby(maxDist)
	local root = hrp()
	if not root then
		local _, err = M.RequireAlive()
		return 0, err
	end
	local origin = root.Position
	local n = 0
	for _, pl in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if pl ~= LocalPlayer then
			local otherChar = pl.Character
			local otherHrp = otherChar and otherChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if otherHrp and (otherHrp.Position - origin).Magnitude <= (maxDist or 12) then
				for _, name in ipairs({ "CarryPrompt", "MedicCarryPrompt" }) do
					local prompt = otherHrp:FindFirstChild(name)
					if prompt and prompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
						pcall(fireproximityprompt, prompt)
						n = n + 1
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return n
end

-- MOVIMENTO
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local MV = {}
M.Movement = MV

MV._flyConn = nil
MV._flySpeed = 80
MV._flyEnabled = false

-- JumpPower: persiste sozinho, implementação simples
function MV.SetJumpPower(power)
	local h = hum()
	if not h then return M.RequireAlive() end
	backup("JumpPower", h.JumpPower)
	backup("UseJumpPower", h.UseJumpPower)
	pcall(function()
		h.UseJumpPower = true
		h.JumpPower = power
	end)
	return true
end

function MV.RestoreJumpPower()
	restore("JumpPower", function(v) local h = hum() if h then h.JumpPower = v end end)
	restore("UseJumpPower", function(v) local h = hum() if h then h.UseJumpPower = v end end)
end

-- Infinite jump
MV._ijConn = nil
function MV.InfiniteJump(enabled)
	if MV._ijConn then
		pcall(function() MV._ijConn:Disconnect() end)
		MV._ijConn = nil
	end
	if not enabled then return end
	MV._ijConn = UserInputService.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
		local h = hum()
		if h and h:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping then
			pcall(function() h:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping) end)
		end
	end)
end

-- Noclip por janela curta — nunca 2s contínuos (detector "c")
function MV.NoclipPulse(duration)
	local c = char()
	if not c then return M.RequireAlive() end
	local saved = {}
	for _, p in ipairs(c:GetDescendants()) do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") then
			table.insert(saved, { part = p, cc = p.CanCollide })
			pcall(function() p.CanCollide = false end)
		end
	end
	local d = math.clamp(duration or 1.5, 0.1, 1.9)
	task.delay(d, function()
		for _, e in ipairs(saved) do
			pcall(function()
				if e.part and e.part.Parent then e.part.CanCollide = e.cc end
			end)
		end
	end)
	return true
end

-- Noclip contínuo com flicker (liga 1.2s, desliga 0.9s)
MV._noclipConn = nil
function MV.NoclipContinuous(enabled)
	if MV._noclipConn then
		pcall(function() MV._noclipConn:Disconnect() end)
		MV._noclipConn = nil
	end
	if not enabled then return end
	MV._noclipConn = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
		local c = char()
		if not c then return end
		local phase = os.clock() % 2.1
		local off = phase < 1.2
		for _, p in ipairs(c:GetDescendants()) do
			if p:IsA("BasePart") then
				pcall(function() p.CanCollide = not off end)
			end
		end
	end)
end

-- Fly via CFrame (sem BodyMover — evita detector "f")
function MV.Fly(enabled)
	MV._flyEnabled = enabled
	if MV._flyConn then
		pcall(function() MV._flyConn:Disconnect() end)
		MV._flyConn = nil
	end
	if not enabled then
		local r = hrp()
		if r then pcall(function() r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero end) end
		return
	end
	MV._flyConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
		if not MV._flyEnabled then return end
		local r = hrp()
		local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not r or not cam then return end

		local move = Vector3.zero
		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then move += cam.CFrame.LookVector end
		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then move -= cam.CFrame.LookVector end
		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then move -= cam.CFrame.RightVector end
		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then move += cam.CFrame.RightVector end
		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then move += Vector3.yAxis end
		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then move -= Vector3.yAxis end

		if move.Magnitude > 0 then
			move = move.Unit * MV._flySpeed * dt
		end
		pcall(function()
			r.CFrame = r.CFrame + move
			r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		end)
	end)
end

function MV.SetFlySpeed(v)
	MV._flySpeed = math.clamp(v, 10, 400)
end

-- Teleporte para coordenadas
function MV.Teleport(x, y, z)
	local r = hrp()
	if not r then return M.RequireAlive() end
	pcall(function() r.CFrame = CFrame.new(x, y, z) end)
	return true
end

-- Teleporte para o inimigo mais próximo
function MV.TeleportToEnemy()
	local r = hrp()
	if not r then return M.RequireAlive() end
	local myTeam = LocalPlayer.Team
	local origin = r.Position
	local best, bestD
	for _, pl in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if pl ~= LocalPlayer and pl.Team ~= myTeam then
			local c = pl.Character
			local t = c and c:FindFirstChild("Torso")
			if c and c.Parent and t then
				local d = (t.Position - origin).Magnitude
				if not bestD or d < bestD then best, bestD = t, d end
			end
		end
	end
	if not best then return false end
	pcall(function() r.CFrame = CFrame.new(best.Position + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)) end)
	return true, bestD
end

-- GUN MODS
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local G = {}
M.Gun = G

G._fxBackup = {}

function G.CleanEffects(enabled)
	local folder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Particles")
	if not folder then return false end
	for _, obj in ipairs(folder:GetDescendants()) do
		if obj:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or obj:IsA("Beam") then
			if enabled then
				if G._fxBackup[obj] == nil then G._fxBackup[obj] = obj.Enabled end
				pcall(function() obj.Enabled = false end)
			end
		end
	end
	if not enabled then
		for obj, v in pairs(G._fxBackup) do
			pcall(function()
				if obj and obj.Parent then obj.Enabled = v end
			end)
		end
		table.clear(G._fxBackup)
	end
	return true
end

function G.NoMuzzleFlash(enabled)
	local folder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Particles")
	local mf = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("MuzzleFlashes")
	if not mf then return false end
	for _, obj in ipairs(mf:GetDescendants()) do
		if obj:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or obj:IsA("PointLight") or obj:IsA("Beam") then
			pcall(function() obj.Enabled = not enabled end)
		end
	end
	return true
end

-- No recoil: hook no CameraModule via offset de CFrame
-- O jogo aplica kick na câmera; interceptar requer hook no módulo.
-- Alternativa SAFE: suavizar a leitura de CFrame não é possível sem hook.
-- Implementação honesta: reduz o efeito visual do muzzle, não o recoil real.
G._recoilNote = "Recoil é server+client; hook necessário (não implementado)"

-- INFO / RECON
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local I = {}
M.Info = I

function I.ServerInfo()
	local lines = {}
	lines[#lines+1] = "JobId: " .. tostring(game.JobId)
	lines[#lines+1] = "PlaceId: " .. tostring(game.PlaceId)
	lines[#lines+1] = "Jogador: " .. LocalPlayer.Name .. " (" .. tostring(LocalPlayer.UserId) .. ")"
	lines[#lines+1] = "Time: " .. tostring(LocalPlayer.Team and LocalPlayer.Team.Name or "?")
	lines[#lines+1] = "Jogadores: " .. #Players:GetPlayers()
	lines[#lines+1] = "Ping: " .. string.format("%.0f ms", LocalPlayer:GetNetworkPing() * 1000)
	return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

function I.SectorStatus()
	local ok, SB = pcall(require, ReplicatedStorage.Client.MatchHud.SectorBoard)
	if not ok then return "SectorBoard indisponível" end
	local lines = {}
	local okc, counts = pcall(function() return SB:GetOwnedCounts() end)
	if okc and type(counts) == "table" then
		for k, v in pairs(counts) do lines[#lines+1] = k .. ": " .. tostring(v) end
	end
	local okf, front = pcall(function() return SB:GetFrontline() end)
	if okf and type(front) == "table" then
		lines[#lines+1] = "Fronteira: " .. #front .. " células"
	end
	local okg, grid = pcall(function() return SB:GetGrid() end)
	if okg and grid then
		lines[#lines+1] = string.format("Grid: %sx%s (%s studs cada)", tostring(grid.Columns), tostring(grid.Rows), tostring(grid.SectorSize))
	end
	return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

function I.TargetList()
	local lines = {}
	local myTeam = LocalPlayer.Team
	local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
	local origin = cam and cam.CFrame.Position or Vector3.zero
	local n = 0
	for _, pl in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if pl ~= LocalPlayer and pl.Team ~= myTeam then
			local c = pl.Character
			local t = c and c:FindFirstChild("Torso")
			local h = c and c:FindFirstChild("Head")
			if c and c.Parent and t and h then
				n = n + 1
				local hh = h:FindFirstChild("Health")
				local th = t:FindFirstChild("Health")
				local dist = (t.Position - origin).Magnitude
				local ok, sp, on = pcall(function() return cam:WorldToViewportPoint(t.Position) end)
				lines[#lines+1] = string.format("%d. %s | %.0fm | Head=%s Torso=%s | tela=%s",
					n, pl.Name, dist,
					hh and tostring(math.floor(hh.Value)) or "?",
					th and tostring(math.floor(th.Value)) or "?",
					tostring(ok and on or false))
			end
		end
	end
	return #lines > 0 and table.concat(lines, "\n") or "Nenhum inimigo"
end

function I.PlayerCount()
	local t = { NATO = 0, PACT = 0, Outros = 0 }
	for _, pl in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local name = pl.Team and pl.Team.Name
		if name == "NATO" then t.NATO += 1
		elseif name == "PACT" then t.PACT += 1
		else t.Outros += 1 end
	end
	return string.format("NATO: %d | PACT: %d | Outros: %d", t.NATO, t.PACT, t.Outros)
end

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- LIMPEZA TOTAL
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function M.RestoreAll()
	P.MuteDebuffs(false)
	P.NoSuppressionEffects(false)
	P.FullBright(false)
	P.NoFog(false)
	P.ExtendedThirdPerson(false)
	P.RemovePostFX(false)
	P.NoVegetation(false)
	P.Xray(false)
	MV.RestoreJumpPower()
	MV.InfiniteJump(false)
	MV.NoclipContinuous(false)
	MV.Fly(false)
	G.CleanEffects(false)
	G.NoMuzzleFlash(false)
	for _, c in ipairs(M._conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
	table.clear(M._conns)
	table.clear(M._backup)
end

return M

end
local Modules = __load_Modules()

-- ===================================================================
-- WIRE (abas ESP/Aimbot/Sistema)
-- ===================================================================
local function __load_Wire()
--[[
	═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
	COLD WAR [VIETNAM] — WIRING DA UI
	Registra as features do Core nas abas da Library.

	Contrato com a UI (verificado em script.txt):
	  Window:AddTab(name, desc) → tab
	  tab:AddSection(text)
	  tab:AddToggle({ Name, Description, Default, Flag, Callback })
	  tab:AddSlider({ Name, Min, Max, Default, Increment, Suffix, Flag, Callback })
	  tab:AddDropdown({ Name, Options, Default, Multi, Flag, Callback })
	  tab:AddKeybind({ Name, Default, Flag, Changed })
	  tab:AddInput({ Name, Placeholder, Default, Flag, NoConfig, Live })
	  tab:AddButton({ Name, Callback })
	  tab:AddLabel(text)
	  tab:AddColorPicker({ Name, Default, Flag, Callback })
	  Window:Notify(title, text, duration, kind)
	═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
]]

local function Wire(window, core, overrider)
	local W = {}
	W._overrider = overrider

	-- helpers ------------------------------------------------------------
	local function notify(title, text, kind)
		pcall(function() window:Notify(title, text, 2.5, kind or "info") end)
	end

	local function toggle(tab, name, desc, default, flag, cb)
		return tab:AddToggle({
			Name = name, Description = desc, Default = default, Flag = flag,
			Callback = function(v) pcall(cb, v) end,
		})
	end

	local function slider(tab, name, min, max, default, inc, suffix, flag, cb)
		return tab:AddSlider({
			Name = name, Min = min, Max = max, Default = default,
			Increment = inc, Suffix = suffix, Flag = flag,
			Callback = function(v) pcall(cb, v) end,
		})
	end

	-- ═════════════════════════ ESP / VISUAL ═════════════════════════
	function W.BuildESP(tab)
		tab:AddSection("Master")

		toggle(tab, "Ligar ESP", "Renderiza as opções marcadas abaixo", false, "esp_master", function(v)
			core:SetESP(v)
			if v then core:Start() end
		end)

		tab:AddSection("Elementos")

		toggle(tab, "Caixa", "Retângulo ao redor do alvo", true, "esp_box", function(v)
			core:SetESPConfig("Boxes", v)
		end)

		toggle(tab, "Nome", "Nome do jogador acima da cabeça", true, "esp_name", function(v)
			core:SetESPConfig("Names", v)
		end)

		toggle(tab, "Barra de vida", "Vida somada das 6 partes", true, "esp_health", function(v)
			core:SetESPConfig("Health", v)
		end)

		toggle(tab, "Distância", "Metros abaixo do alvo", true, "esp_dist", function(v)
			core:SetESPConfig("Distance", v)
		end)

		toggle(tab, "Tracer", "Linha da base da tela até o alvo", false, "esp_tracer", function(v)
			core:SetESPConfig("Tracer", v)
		end)

		tab:AddSection("Filtros")

		toggle(tab, "Ignorar time", "Não mostra aliados", true, "esp_teamcheck", function(v)
			core:SetESPConfig("TeamCheck", v)
		end)

		toggle(tab, "Só invisíveis", "Mostra apenas quem está com atributo Invisible", false, "esp_invonly", function(v)
			core:SetESPConfig("InvisibleOnly", v)
		end)

		tab:AddSection("Objetivos")

		toggle(tab, "Status dos setores", "Contagem de setores por time no console", false, "esp_sectors", function(v)
			if not v then return end
			local SB = core:GetSectorBoard()
			if not SB then
				notify("SectorBoard", "Módulo não disponível", "error")
				return
			end
			local ok, counts = pcall(function() return SB:GetOwnedCounts() end)
			if ok and type(counts) == "table" then
				local parts = {}
				for k, val in pairs(counts) do
					table.insert(parts, k .. "=" .. tostring(val))
				end
				notify("Setores", table.concat(parts, "  "), "success")
			else
				notify("Setores", "Falha ao ler", "error")
			end
		end)

		tab:AddButton({
			Name = "Listar alvos no console",
			Callback = function()
				local targets = core:GetTargets()
				print(("[ESP] %d alvo(s)"):format(#targets))
				for i, t in ipairs(targets) do
					print(string.format(
						"  %d. %s | time=%s | %.0fm | vida=%.0f%% | invis=%s | disfarcado=%s",
						i, t.Player.Name, t.TeamName, t.Distance,
						(t.HealthPct or 0) * 100,
						tostring(t.Invisible), tostring(t.Disguised)
					))
				end
				notify("Alvos", ("%d encontrado(s) — ver console"):format(#targets), "info")
			end,
		})
	end

	-- ═════════════════════════ AIMBOT ═════════════════════════
	function W.BuildAimbot(tab)
		tab:AddSection("Master")

		toggle(tab, "Ligar Aimbot", "Mira automática no alvo mais próximo do centro", false, "aim_master", function(v)
			core:SetAimbot(v)
			if v then core:Start() end
		end)

		tab:AddDropdown({
			Name = "Modo",
			Options = { "Camera", "Silent", "Native" },
			Default = "Camera",
			Flag = "aim_mode",
			Callback = function(v) pcall(core.SetAimbotConfig, core, "Mode", v) end,
		})

		tab:AddDropdown({
			Name = "Parte do corpo",
			Options = { "Head", "Torso" },
			Default = "Head",
			Flag = "aim_part",
			Callback = function(v) pcall(core.SetAimbotConfig, core, "Part", v) end,
		})

		tab:AddSection("Ajustes")

		slider(tab, "FOV", 10, 400, 120, 5, "px", "aim_fov", function(v)
			core:SetAimbotConfig("FOV", v)
		end)

		slider(tab, "Suavidade", 1, 20, 1, 1, "x", "aim_smooth", function(v)
			core:SetAimbotConfig("Smoothness", v)
		end)

		tab:AddSection("Filtros")

		toggle(tab, "Ignorar time", "Não mira em aliados", true, "aim_teamcheck", function(v)
			core:SetAimbotConfig("TeamCheck", v)
		end)

		toggle(tab, "Checar parede", "Ignora alvos atrás de obstáculo", true, "aim_wallcheck", function(v)
			core:SetAimbotConfig("WallCheck", v)
		end)

		toggle(tab, "Ignorar disfarçados", "Pula quem está com tag Disguised", false, "aim_ignore_disg", function(v)
			core:SetAimbotConfig("IgnoreDisguised", v)
		end)

		toggle(tab, "Ignorar inconscientes", "Pula quem está nocauteado", true, "aim_ignore_unc", function(v)
			core:SetAimbotConfig("IgnoreUnconscious", v)
		end)

		tab:AddSection("Aim assist nativo (jogo)")

		local has = core:HasNativeAssist()
		tab:AddLabel(has
			and "Função assist do jogo localizada. Usa o código original do Cold War — mira suave, team check e LOS nativos."
			or "Função assist não encontrada. Este jogo pode ter mudado.")

		if has then
			toggle(tab, "Ligar aim assist nativo", "Chama o assist() do jogo fora do gate de gamepad", false, "aim_native", function(v)
				core:SetNativeAA(v)
				if v then core:Start() end
			end)

			slider(tab, "Força", 0, 100, 100, 5, "%", "aim_native_str", function(v)
				core:SetNativeAAConfig("Strength", v / 100)
			end)

			slider(tab, "Suavidade", 1, 20, 4, 1, "x", "aim_native_smooth", function(v)
				core:SetNativeAAConfig("Smoothness", v)
			end)
		end
	end

	-- ═════════════════════════ SISTEMA ═════════════════════════
	function W.BuildSystem(tab)
		tab:AddSection("Bypass")

		local statusLabel = tab:AddLabel("Status: verificando...")

		local function refreshStatus()
			local on = core:BypassEnabled()
			pcall(function()
				statusLabel.Text = on
					and "Status: ATIVO — remotes do anticheat renomeados"
					or "Status: inativo — detectores do jogo estão transmitindo"
			end)
		end

		toggle(tab, "Silenciar detectores", "Renomeia StreamingHint e MovementPing client-side", false, "sys_bypass", function(v)
			if v then
				local ok, msg = core:ApplyBypass()
				notify(ok and "Bypass ativo" or "Bypass falhou", tostring(msg), ok and "success" or "error")
			else
				core:RemoveBypass()
				notify("Bypass desligado", "Remotes restaurados", "info")
			end
			refreshStatus()
		end)

		tab:AddButton({
			Name = "Verificar estado do bypass",
			Callback = function()
				refreshStatus()
				notify("Bypass", core:BypassEnabled() and "ATIVO" or "inativo", "info")
			end,
		})

		tab:AddSection("Diagnóstico")

		tab:AddButton({
			Name = "Rodar diagnóstico",
			Callback = function()
				local diag = core:Diagnostics()
				print("[DIAG]\n" .. diag)
				notify("Diagnóstico", "Resultado no console (F9)", "info")
			end,
		})

		tab:AddButton({
			Name = "Desligar tudo e descarregar",
			Callback = function()
				core:Destroy()
				notify("Cheat desligado", "Todas as features pararam", "warn")
			end,
		})
	end

	-- ═════════════════════════ REGISTRO ═════════════════════════
	-- Chamado como W.BuildAll(tabs) — SEM self, pois tabs e o unico argumento.
	function W.BuildAll(tabs)
		local errors = {}
		local function run(label, fn, tab)
			if not tab then
				table.insert(errors, label .. ": aba ausente")
				return
			end
			local ok, err = pcall(fn, tab)
			if not ok then
				table.insert(errors, label .. ": " .. tostring(err))
			end
		end
		run("ESP", W.BuildESP, tabs.ESP)
		run("Aimbot", W.BuildAimbot, tabs.Aimbot)
		run("Sistema", W.BuildSystem, tabs.System)
		if #errors > 0 then
			warn("[COLDWAR] wiring: " .. table.concat(errors, " | "))
			pcall(function()
				window:Notify("Erro no wiring", table.concat(errors, "\n"), 8, "error")
			end)
		end
		return #errors == 0, errors
	end

	return W
end

return Wire

end
local Wire = __load_Wire()

-- ===================================================================
-- WIRE-EXT (abas Gun/Movimento/Player/Info)
-- ===================================================================
local function __load_WireExt()
--[[
	═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
	WIRE ESTENDIDO — constrói os widgets dos módulos adicionais
	Recebe: tab, Modules (M), Overrider (O), window
	═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
]]

local WireExt = {}

-- Mostra o erro de guarda do módulo, se houver
local function reportError(M, window, contexto)
	local err = M.LastError and M.LastError()
	if err then
		M.ClearError()
		pcall(function() window:Notify(contexto or "Aviso", err, 4, "warn") end)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

-- GUN MODS
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function WireExt.BuildGun(tab, M, O, window)
	tab:AddSection("VISUAL DE ARMAS")

	tab:AddToggle({
		Name = "Sem muzzle flash",
		Description = "Remove o clarão do cano",
		Default = false,
		Flag = "gun_noflash",
		Callback = function(v)
			pcall(function() M.Gun.NoMuzzleFlash(v) end)
		end,
	})

	tab:AddToggle({
		Name = "Limpar partículas",
		Description = "Desliga todos os ParticleEmitter/Beam",
		Default = false,
		Flag = "gun_cleanfx",
		Callback = function(v)
			pcall(function() M.Gun.CleanEffects(v) end)
		end,
	})

	tab:AddSection("DANO / BALÍSTICA")
	tab:AddLabel("Espalhamento e dano são calculados no servidor.\nNenhuma dessas funções é exposta ao cliente.")
	tab:AddLabel("Recoil: o kick é aplicado pelo CameraModule antes\ndo RenderStepped — exigiria hook de CFrame.")

	tab:AddSection("INFO DE ARMAS")
	tab:AddButton({
		Name = "Listar armas no personagem",
		Description = "Modelos terminados em 'Model'",
		Callback = function()
			local lines = {}
			local ch = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character
			if ch then
				for _, obj in ipairs(ch:GetChildren()) do
					if obj:IsA("Model") and obj.Name:match("Model$") then
						table.insert(lines, obj.Name)
					end
				end
			end
			if #lines > 0 then
				print("[COLDWAR] Armas: " .. table.concat(lines, ", "))
				pcall(function() window:Notify("Armas", table.concat(lines, "\n"), 6, "info") end)
			else
				pcall(function() window:Notify("Armas", "Nenhuma arma equipada", 4, "warn") end)
			end
		end,
	})
end

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- MOVIMENTO
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function WireExt.BuildMovement(tab, M, O, window)
	tab:AddSection("VELOCIDADE")
	tab:AddLabel("SpeedMultiplier é server-authoritative (revertido em <200ms).\nWalkSpeed só persiste com override por frame.")
	tab:AddLabel("Não existe speed hack viável neste jogo.")

	tab:AddSlider({
		Name = "WalkSpeed (override)",
		Description = "Reescrito todo frame — pode ser detectado como Speed",
		Min = 16,
		Max = 120,
		Default = 16,
		Increment = 1,
		Suffix = " studs/s",
		Flag = "mv_walkspeed",
		Callback = function(v)
			pcall(function()
				if v > 16 then
					O.ClaimWalkSpeed(v)
					local hum = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character
						and game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
					local base = hum and hum.WalkSpeed or 16
					O.Set("climbspeed", v * 0.9)
					O.Claim("jumppower_base", "JumpPower", function(pv)
						local h = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character
							and game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
						if h then
							h.UseJumpPower = true
							h.JumpPower = pv
						end
					end, v * 0.5)
				else
					O.Release("walkspeed")
					O.Release("climbspeed")
					O.Release("jumppower_base")
				end
			end)
		end,
	})

	tab:AddSection("PULO")

	tab:AddSlider({
		Name = "Força do pulo",
		Description = "JumpPower — persiste sem override",
		Min = 15,
		Max = 200,
		Default = 70,
		Increment = 5,
		Flag = "mv_jump",
		Callback = function(v)
			pcall(function()
				M.Movement.SetJumpPower(v)
				reportError(M, window, "Pulo")
			end)
		end,
	})

	tab:AddToggle({
		Name = "Pulo infinito",
		Description = "Pula no ar quantas vezes quiser",
		Default = false,
		Flag = "mv_infjump",
		Callback = function(v)
			pcall(function() M.Movement.InfiniteJump(v) end)
		end,
	})

	tab:AddToggle({
		Name = "Auto pulo",
		Description = "Pula automaticamente ao tocar o chão",
		Default = false,
		Flag = "mv_autojump",
		Callback = function(v)
			pcall(function()
				if WireExt._autojump then
					pcall(function() WireExt._autojump:Disconnect() end)
					WireExt._autojump = nil
				end
				if not v then return end
				WireExt._autojump = game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function()
					local ch = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character
					local h = ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
					if h and h:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed then
						pcall(function() h:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping) end)
					end
				end)
			end)
		end,
	})

	tab:AddSection("FLY")

	tab:AddToggle({
		Name = "Fly",
		Description = "WASD + Space/Ctrl · sem BodyMover",
		Default = false,
		Flag = "mv_fly",
		Callback = function(v)
			pcall(function() M.Movement.Fly(v) end)
		end,
	})

	tab:AddSlider({
		Name = "Velocidade do fly",
		Description = "studs por segundo",
		Min = 20,
		Max = 400,
		Default = 80,
		Increment = 10,
		Suffix = " s/s",
		Flag = "mv_flyspeed",
		Callback = function(v)
			pcall(function() M.Movement.SetFlySpeed(v) end)
		end,
	})

	tab:AddSection("COLISÃO")
	tab:AddLabel("Noclip contínuo >2s dispara o detector 'c'.\nO pulse fica em 1.9s máx, o contínuo faz flicker.")

	tab:AddButton({
		Name = "Noclip pulse (1.9s)",
		Description = "Atravessa paredes por 1.9 segundo",
		Callback = function()
			pcall(function()
				local ok, err = M.Movement.NoclipPulse(1.9)
				if reportError(M, window, "Noclip") then return end
				pcall(function() window:Notify("Noclip", "Ativo por 1.9s", 2, "info") end)
			end)
		end,
	})

	tab:AddToggle({
		Name = "Noclip contínuo",
		Description = "Flicker 1.2s on / 0.9s off",
		Default = false,
		Flag = "mv_noclip",
		Callback = function(v)
			pcall(function() M.Movement.NoclipContinuous(v) end)
		end,
	})

	tab:AddSection("TELEPORTE")

	tab:AddInput({
		Name = "Coordenadas",
		Placeholder = "x, y, z",
		Default = "",
		Flag = "mv_tpcoords",
		NoConfig = true,
	})

	tab:AddButton({
		Name = "Teleportar para coordenadas",
		Description = "Usa o campo acima",
		Callback = function()
			pcall(function()
				local obj = window.Flags["mv_tpcoords"]
				local txt = obj and obj:Get() or ""
				local x, y, z = txt:match("(-?%d+%.?%d*)%s*,%s*(-?%d+%.?%d*)%s*,%s*(-?%d+%.?%d*)")
				if not x then
					pcall(function() window:Notify("Teleporte", "Formato: x, y, z", 4, "warn") end)
					return
				end
				M.Movement.Teleport(tonumber(x), tonumber(y), tonumber(z))
				pcall(function() window:Notify("Teleporte", "Ok", 2, "success") end)
			end)
		end,
	})

	tab:AddButton({
		Name = "Teleportar ao inimigo mais próximo",
		Description = "Movimento detectável — use com cuidado",
		Callback = function()
			pcall(function()
				local ok, dist = M.Movement.TeleportToEnemy()
				pcall(function()
					window:Notify("Teleporte", ok and string.format("Ok (%.0f studs)", dist) or "Nenhum inimigo", 3, ok and "success" or "warn")
				end)
			end)
		end,
	})

	tab:AddSection("RESTAURAR")
	tab:AddButton({
		Name = "Restaurar movimento",
		Description = "Desfaz fly, noclip, speed e pulo",
		Callback = function()
			pcall(function()
				M.Movement.Fly(false)
				M.Movement.NoclipContinuous(false)
				M.Movement.InfiniteJump(false)
				M.Movement.RestoreJumpPower()
				if O then
					O.Release("walkspeed")
					O.Release("jumppower_base")
				end
				pcall(function() window:Notify("Movimento", "Restaurado", 3, "success") end)
			end)
		end,
	})
end

-- INFO / RECON
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function WireExt.BuildInfo(tab, M, O, window)
	tab:AddSection("SERVIDOR")

	tab:AddButton({
		Name = "JobId / PlaceId / Ping",
		Description = "Informações da sessão",
		Callback = function()
			pcall(function()
				local txt = M.Info.ServerInfo()
				print("[COLDWAR]\n" .. txt)
				pcall(function() window:Notify("Servidor", txt, 8, "info") end)
			end)
		end,
	})

	tab:AddButton({
		Name = "Contagem de jogadores",
		Description = "NATO vs PACT",
		Callback = function()
			pcall(function()
				local txt = M.Info.PlayerCount()
				pcall(function() window:Notify("Times", txt, 4, "info") end)
			end)
		end,
	})

	tab:AddSection("SETORES")

	tab:AddButton({
		Name = "Status dos setores",
		Description = "Owned counts + fronteira + grid",
		Callback = function()
			pcall(function()
				local txt = M.Info.SectorStatus()
				print("[COLDWAR] Setores:\n" .. txt)
				pcall(function() window:Notify("Setores", txt, 8, "info") end)
			end)
		end,
	})

	tab:AddButton({
		Name = "Frontline detalhada",
		Description = "Células na linha de frente",
		Callback = function()
			pcall(function()
				local SB = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Client.MatchHud.SectorBoard)
				local front = SB:GetFrontline()
				local lines = {}
				for _, cell in ipairs(front or {}) do
					if type(cell) == "table" then
						table.insert(lines, string.format("(%s,%s)", tostring(cell.Col or cell.X or "?"), tostring(cell.Row or cell.Y or "?")))
					else
						table.insert(lines, tostring(cell))
					end
				end
				local txt = #lines > 0 and table.concat(lines, " ") or "Sem dados"
				pcall(function() window:Notify("Frontline", txt, 8, "info") end)
			end)
		end,
	})

	tab:AddSection("JOGADORES")

	tab:AddButton({
		Name = "Listar inimigos",
		Description = "Distância, vida e visibilidade",
		Callback = function()
			pcall(function()
				local txt = M.Info.TargetList()
				print("[COLDWAR] Alvos:\n" .. txt)
				pcall(function() window:Notify("Inimigos", txt, 10, "info") end)
			end)
		end,
	})

	tab:AddButton({
		Name = "Inventário",
		Description = "Armas e itens do Backpack",
		Callback = function()
			pcall(function()
				local lines = {}
				local ch = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character
				if ch then
					for _, o in ipairs(ch:GetChildren()) do
						if o:IsA("Model") and o.Name:match("Model$") then
							table.insert(lines, "Arma: " .. o.Name)
						end
					end
				end
				local bp = game.Players.LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
				if bp then
					for _, it in ipairs(bp:GetChildren()) do
						table.insert(lines, "Item: " .. it.Name)
					end
				end
				pcall(function()
					window:Notify("Inventário", #lines > 0 and table.concat(lines, "\n") or "Vazio", 8, "info")
				end)
			end)
		end,
	})

	tab:AddSection("TELEMETRIA DO JOGO")
	tab:AddLabel("O anticheat envia PhysicsFps e Ping a cada 10s.\nO ESP não altera o physFPS (medido: 60.0 fixo).")

	tab:AddButton({
		Name = "Medir FPS e physFPS",
		Description = "Amostra de 1 segundo",
		Callback = function()
			pcall(function()
				local rs = game:GetService("RunService")
				local t0, frames = os.clock(), 0
				local conn
				conn = rs.RenderStepped:Connect(function() frames = frames + 1 end)
				task.wait(1)
				conn:Disconnect()
				local fps = frames / (os.clock() - t0)
				local phys = workspace:GetRealPhysicsFPS()
				local txt = string.format("render: %.1f fps\nphysics: %.1f fps", fps, phys)
				pcall(function() window:Notify("Performance", txt, 5, "info") end)
			end)
		end,
	})
end

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- REGISTRO
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function WireExt.BuildAll(tabs, M, O, window)
	WireExt._window = window
	local errors = {}
	local function run(label, fn, tab)
		if not tab then
			table.insert(errors, label .. ": aba ausente")
			return
		end
		local ok, err = pcall(fn, tab, M, O, window)
		if not ok then
			table.insert(errors, label .. ": " .. tostring(err))
		end
	end
	run("Gun", WireExt.BuildGun, tabs.Gun)
	run("Movimento", WireExt.BuildMovement, tabs.Move)
	run("Player", WireExt.BuildPlayer, tabs.Player)
	run("Info", WireExt.BuildInfo, tabs.Info)

	if #errors > 0 then
		warn("[COLDWAR] wire-ext: " .. table.concat(errors, " | "))
		pcall(function()
			window:Notify("Erro no wire", table.concat(errors, "\n"), 8, "error")
		end)
	end
	return #errors == 0, errors
end

return WireExt

end
local WireExt = __load_WireExt()

local Window = Library.new("MEU SCRIPT", "v4.0")

local tabESP    = Window:AddTab("ESP / Visual",       "Opções de visualização e overlays")
local tabAimbot = Window:AddTab("Aimbot",             "Configurações de mira")
local tabGun    = Window:AddTab("Gun mods",           "Modificações de armas")
local tabMove   = Window:AddTab("Movimento",          "Controles de locomoção")
local tabPlayer = Window:AddTab("Player / Utilidade", "Ferramentas do jogador e utilidades")
local tabInfo   = Window:AddTab("Info / Recon",       "Informações do jogo e dos jogadores")
local tabSystem = Window:AddTab("Sistema",            "Configurações do menu e do script")

tabSystem:AddSection("Aparência")

local themeNames = {}
for _, th in ipairs(Themes) do table.insert(themeNames, th[1]) end

local accentPicker
tabSystem:AddDropdown({
	Name = "Tema de cor",
	Options = themeNames,
	Default = themeNames[1],
	Flag = "Tema",
	Callback = function(name)
		local th = Window:SetTheme(name)
		if th and accentPicker then accentPicker:Set(th[2], true) end
		if not Window.Loading then
			Window:Notify("Tema aplicado", "Esquema de cores: " .. name, 2.5, "success")
		end
	end,
})
accentPicker = tabSystem:AddColorPicker({
	Name = "Cor de destaque personalizada",
	Default = Themes[1][2],
	Flag = "CorDestaque",
	Callback = function(c)
		local h, s, v = c:ToHSV()
		local c2 = Color3.fromHSV((h + 0.1) % 1, math.clamp(s, 0.35, 1), math.clamp(v, 0.7, 1))
		Window:SetAccent(c, c2, true)
	end,
})
tabSystem:AddSlider({
	Name = "Opacidade da janela",
	Min = 0, Max = 40, Default = 0, Increment = 1, Suffix = "%",
	Flag = "Opacidade",
	Callback = function(v)
		Window.BaseT = v / 100
		if Window.Open then tween(Window.Main, { GroupTransparency = Window.BaseT }, 0.2) end
	end,
})
tabSystem:AddSlider({
	Name = "Velocidade das animações",
	Min = 0.5, Max = 2, Default = 1, Increment = 0.1, Suffix = "x",
	Flag = "VelocidadeAnim",
	Callback = function(v) Theme.Speed = v end,
})
tabSystem:AddToggle({
	Name = "Partículas de fundo",
	Default = true,
	Flag = "Particulas",
	Callback = function(v) Window.ParticleFrame.Visible = v end,
})
tabSystem:AddToggle({
	Name = "Borda animada",
	Default = true,
	Flag = "BordaAnimada",
	Callback = function(v)
		Window.BorderAnim = v
		if not v then Window.StrokeGrad.Rotation = 0 end
	end,
})
tabSystem:AddToggle({
	Name = "Barra lateral compacta",
	Default = false,
	Flag = "BarraCompacta",
	Callback = function(v) Window:SetCollapsed(v) end,
})

tabSystem:AddSection("Atalhos")
tabSystem:AddKeybind({
	Name = "Mostrar / ocultar menu",
	Default = Enum.KeyCode.RightShift,
	Flag = "TeclaMenu",
	Changed = function(key)
		Window.ToggleKey = key
		if not Window.Loading then
			Window:Notify("Atalho atualizado", "Nova tecla: " .. key.Name, 2.5, "info")
		end
	end,
})

tabSystem:AddSection("Perfis")
local cfgName = tabSystem:AddInput({
	Name = "Nome do perfil",
	Placeholder = "ex: meu-perfil",
	Default = "padrao",
	Flag = "_cfgNome",
	NoConfig = true,
	Live = true,
})
local cfgList = tabSystem:AddDropdown({
	Name = "Perfis salvos",
	Options = Window:ListConfigs(),
	Flag = "_cfgLista",
	NoConfig = true,
})
tabSystem:AddButton({
	Name = "Salvar perfil",
	Callback = function()
		local ok, res = Window:SaveConfig(cfgName.Value)
		if ok then
			cfgList:Refresh(Window:ListConfigs())
			cfgList:Set(res, true)
			Window:Notify("Perfil salvo", "\"" .. res .. "\" foi salvo.", 3, "success")
		else
			Window:Notify("Não foi possível salvar", tostring(res), 3, "error")
		end
	end,
})
tabSystem:AddButton({
	Name = "Carregar perfil selecionado",
	Callback = function()
		local name = cfgList.Value
		if not name then
			Window:Notify("Nenhum perfil", "Salve ou selecione um perfil primeiro.", 3, "warn")
			return
		end
		local ok, res = Window:LoadConfig(name)
		if ok then
			Window:Notify("Perfil carregado", "\"" .. res .. "\" aplicado.", 3, "success")
		else
			Window:Notify("Não foi possível carregar", tostring(res), 3, "error")
		end
	end,
})
tabSystem:AddButton({
	Name = "Excluir perfil selecionado",
	Callback = function()
		local name = cfgList.Value
		if not name then return end
		local ok = Window:DeleteConfig(name)
		cfgList:Refresh(Window:ListConfigs())
		Window:Notify(ok and "Perfil excluído" or "Falha ao excluir", "\"" .. name .. "\"", 3, ok and "success" or "error")
	end,
})

tabSystem:AddSection("Interface")
tabSystem:AddButton({
	Name = "Descarregar UI",
	Callback = function() Window:Destroy() end,
})

-- ===================================================================
-- LIGA AS FEATURES NAS ABAS
-- ===================================================================
do
	local tabs = {
		ESP = tabESP, Aimbot = tabAimbot, Gun = tabGun, Move = tabMove,
		Player = tabPlayer, Info = tabInfo, System = tabSystem,
	}

	-- overrider sobe com o core
	Overrider.Start()

	local ok1, errs1 = Wire(Window, Core, Overrider).BuildAll(tabs)
	if not ok1 then warn("[COLDWAR] wire incompleto") end

	local ok2, errs2 = WireExt.BuildAll(tabs, Modules, Overrider, Window)
	if not ok2 then warn("[COLDWAR] wire-ext incompleto") end

	-- guarda referencias para o destroy
	_G.__COLDWAR = { Core = Core, Modules = Modules, Overrider = Overrider, Window = Window }
end

return Window
